findings.finding: Upstream module targets newer kernel and different M5 BSP; stage checks module vermagic against selected kernel. These are not Tyrell's frozen inputs.
findings.consequence: A port needs a distinct coherent kernel/header/module/overlay profile and fresh qualification; do not replace retained module bytes.

findings.finding: Overlay adds GPIO5 TE to the v5 panel node. Driver requests both-edge IRQ with NO_AUTOEN and IRQ_DISABLE_UNLAZY. IRQ learns timing and disables after idle count exceeds te_idle_edges; default20 therefore disables on the 21st counted edge.
findings.consequence: Require actual wiring/overlay validation and measured active/idle IRQ behavior; source comments do not establish electrical behavior.

findings.finding: Missing TE or disabled parameter bypasses waits. Each default wait times out after50ms with a warning, then execution may proceed without reliable phase. Scan selection tries up to4 times; runtime parameters and workqueue/SPI/mutex scheduling prevent an overall hard-deadline claim.
findings.consequence: Record blind/fresh/slept/timeout behavior separately and do not infer tear-free output from a completed request.

findings.finding: Native RGB565 fast path copies each damaged row to scratch memory, then swaps/transposes into the transfer buffer. It rejects I/O-memory and imported GEM buffers; generic conversion/transpose remains the fallback.
findings.consequence: Host ordinary-RAM copy tests cannot reproduce write-combined GEM cost, kernel behavior, SPI timing or scanout.

findings.finding: PRESENT drains deferred/damage work and returns0; display transfer failures are logged in the void dirty callback rather than returned through this ioctl.
findings.consequence: Neither0 nor ioctl throughput is successful optical completion or a transfer-error counter. A userspace timeout cannot bound an already blocked kernel operation.

findings.finding: Rust framebuffer opening executes PRESENT as a capability probe. Later present returns false for unavailable/failed ioctl. Display abstraction permits a caller timer; docs describe20ms fallback. Framebuffer sync invokes fsync but discards its result.
findings.consequence: Do not copy the probe or error suppression into Tyrell. Preserve current fbdev/fsync behavior and foreground/input lifecycle; unsupported and failed operations need separate diagnostics.

findings.finding: Standalone installer writes live module and boot paths and edits boot configuration. Package postinst copies overlays to FAT boot; postrm runs depmod and does not establish complete restoration of copied boot files.
findings.consequence: No inspected installer was executed. These paths are not an accepted Tyrell staging, rollback or recovery workflow.

findings.finding: Repository root declares MIT but driver explicitly declares GPL-2.0 with original Noralf Tronnes authorship. A Rust SDK/root license cannot relicense this kernel source.
findings.consequence: No driver code or header is copied here. Any later distribution requires complete applicable license notices and corresponding source/build material review.
